archetypes.name: dyn-guideline-parser
archetypes.rationale: The new lint mirrors architectural guideline parser boundaries and baseline matching.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new guideline no-exception lint for parser-boundary fidelity. Check that G-* headings, non-entry Markdown headings, deviate bullets, duplicate ids, and line numbers match the shared architectural guideline parser contract. Verify the baseline comparison fails closed for malformed inputs, new findings, and stale rows. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
